text:
mike: Heads up — starting the deploy window for runtime-gateway. Rolling v2.14.0 -> v2.14.1, staged rollout. I'll run telemetry preflight; watchlist = p95 latency, 5xx rate, kv-cache hit rate.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: runtime-gateway v2.14.1. Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% over 30m. Preflight checks enabled. (deployment id: 2041234567) :rocket:

sara: Attaching the quick alert queries I'm watching. Posting panels to the channel.
```
1) canary_error_rate: sum(rate(runtime_errors_total{env="canary"}[5m])) / sum(rate(runtime_requests_total{env="canary"}[5m]))
2) canary_p95: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{env="canary"}[5m])) by (le))
3) kv_cache_hit: sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{env="canary"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{env="canary"}[5m]))
```

ana: Seeing a small p95 spike in us-west-2 canary (2.2s -> 2.8s in the last 7m). Error_rate still ~0.06%. kv_cache_hit down ~5pp. Noted on traces.

mike: hold the ramp at 10% while we dig into traces. Do not increase traffic.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by manual hold (requested by mike). Active shards remain at 10%.

ops-bot: Alert firing: [canary_p95_threshold] canary_p95 > 2.5s for 3m in us-west-2. Incident id: INC-2041.

sara: Copying quick triage steps: 1) run smoke test against canary instances 2) check tail logs for 5xx 3) inspect recent kernel/quantization flags for this model variant.

ana: Ran smoke tests — baseline requests succeed, but a subset of long-context prompts show latency regression. Pasted a trace id: trace:0a7f6c. Looks like KV cache misses for sessions rehydrated after GC.

mike: Good catch. If KV miss rate > 10% or p95 > 3s for 10m, we'll rollback. For now keep pinned at 10%. Sara, can we pin production routing back to v2.14.0 if needed?

sara: Yep. Command ready: `rwdctl traffic pin runtime-gateway --version v2.14.0 --scope prod` (will take ~90s to propagate).

deploy-bot: Note: automated fallback available — route-compatible variant v2.14.0 is healthy.

ana: I'll try a targeted rebuild with an alternate kv-config and run against the canary pool. ETA ~12m.

sara: Proposed rollback criteria (for the record): sustained canary 5xx > 0.5% for 10m OR p95 > 3s for 10m OR kv_cache_hit drop > 15pp for 10m.

mike: Agreed. Logging decision thresholds here. Also adding release notes link for postmortem context: https://rwd.dev/releases/v2.14.1-notes

ops-bot: New status: canary_p95 back to 1.9s after pausing ramp and targeted config change. Alerts cleared.

sara: Nice — reran the smoke test, all green. We'll hold at 10% for another 15m then resume to 50% if no regressions.

mike: No rollback required. I'll update the release channel and add a note to the rollouts doc. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout resumed to 50% at operator request (mike). Monitoring continues.

ops-bot: Final check at 30m: p95 stable, 5xx within baseline, kv_cache_hit back to expected. Closing INC-2041.

sara: Filing a short follow-up to adjust KV cache warmup during gradual rollouts + add a smoke test variant for long-context prompts.

mike: Thanks team — solid run. We'll keep the new checks in the preflight checklist for next release.
